newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere up, banks mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Solidere up, banks mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Solidere rose in heavy demand and bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange in increased turnover on Friday.
Turnover rose to 210,378 from 153,177 for a value of $3,335,861 against $1,768,979.
The LIBX bank index fell 0.31 percent to 171.78. The LISPI general index climbed 0.23 percent to 90.70 and the BLOM general index rose 1.13 percent to 968.66.
Solidere A rose to $10.875 from $10.75 and Solidere B rose to $11.25 from $11.
Among the banks, Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to a record $20 from $19.625 while Banque Audi fell back to $26.25 after jumping to $27 a day earlier.

The bourse said more than 80,000 BLC shares were traded in block trades off the floor on July 2 and 3 at prices ranging between $19.375 and $19.875. On the floor, 10,000 Audi shares traded at $27 on Friday.
Bank of Beirut was unchanged at $4.375 after reporting a higher than expected 72.5 percent rise in mid-year profits on Thursday.
Audi and BLC have not yet issued mid-year results. Brokers say they expect them to be strong.
There was no trade in the four industrial firms, Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blanc, Eternit and Uniceramic.
